label: v125
changes: Emergency card and Babysitter mode now show the number to actually dial, as big tap-to-call buttons, for your country — 144/133/122 in Austria, 999 in the UK, 10111 and 10177 in South Africa, 911 in the US. It's the first thing on the screen, even before you've added anyone
A short welcome tour the first time you open the app, so you can find what's in here. Skippable, never shows twice, and replayable any time from settings
Measure from a photo: snap the bathroom scale, a shoe label or a growth chart and it fills in the height, weight or size for you to check before saving
New under each person's Medical tab: a home for doctor's referrals, X-rays, scan reports and lab results — with an open/booked/done marker so a referral doesn't get forgotten
The growing-up timelapse can use the camera with last year's photo faded over the live view, so this year's shot lines up and the video flows instead of jumping
Pounds, feet and inches for anyone who thinks in them — and a nudge when a child's sizes are getting out of date
Deleting a saved password, bank record or medical entry now asks first, and the buttons are big enough to hit on a phone
You can now remove someone from your space, or permanently delete everything, from Settings. Your backup now includes the actual files, not just links to them
For businesses: work anniversaries, company milestones and a headcount log, plus the things a decent employer remembers — with a "no fuss, please" switch for anyone who'd rather not have one made
Under the hood: two people using the app at the same time can no longer overwrite each other's changes, and far less of your private information is sent to the AI
